preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(A) <= 1000 for A in As)
preconditions.description: Length of each string A is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(B) <= 1000 for B in Bs)
preconditions.description: Length of each string B is between 1 and 1000.
All characters in string A are lowercase.
All characters in string B are lowercase.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['Yes', 'No'] for i in range(T))
all('Yes' in output[i] if any(s1 + s2 == (s1 + s2)[::-1] for s1 in As[i] for s2 in Bs[i]) else 'No' in output[i] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Output is 'Yes' if there exist substrings s1 of A and s2 of B such that s1 + s2 is a palindrome; otherwise 'No'.
